last_updated.description: Mandatory feed-level generation timestamp (RFC 3339 UTC). MUST NOT be computed per-request (always-now anti-pattern).

ttl.description: Seconds a consumer may cache before re-polling. The caching contract.

next_cursor.description: Read-API responses only. Opaque server-side sequence cursor — never a record timestamp.

oneOf.$comment: Plain string is interpreted as language es.

place.$comment: Locator rule enforced via allOf below: address_text OR (lat AND lon). last_confirmed_at key REQUIRED, null legal ('never confirmed' is honest data).

id.description: Publisher's stable local id (int/uuid/hex all acceptable, R3). Opaque; MUST NOT embed personal data (R6).

name.description: CR-2: MUST NOT encode operational state ('(cerrado ahora)' belongs in service_status, not the name).

origin_category.description: Publisher's own category value, verbatim, untranslated. Keeps every crosswalk auditable.

description.description: Publishers MUST strip personal data before publishing (free text is the third leak channel).

municipality_code.description: DIVIPOLA. null permitted ONLY with municipality_text present (validator warning, not error — Q3).

last_confirmed_at.description: Key MUST be present. null = never confirmed (honest). Omission = non-conforming.

confirmed_by.description: Publisher-scoped ROLE/actor token (team, volunteer, official_source, partner:{publisher_id}). MUST NOT be a person's name.

contradictions_active.description: Negative confirmation is a first-class signal.

updated_at.description: CR-1: never a substitute for last_confirmed_at — an edit is not a confirmation.

source.description: Structured provenance, never prose (free-text 'fuente' observed leaking personal names). Aggregators MUST preserve the original chain.

public_url.description: REQUIRED. Link-out is how contact/media/detail reach users WITHOUT travelling in the feed.

contact_available.description: Carries the fact, never the value.

same_as.description: Fully-qualified {publisher_id}:{id} claims. One-hop, non-transitive, never authority (Q5).

allOf.$comment: Locator rule: at least address_text OR both lat+lon. 64% of the reference dataset has no coordinates.

place.$comment: Foreign members preserved (verdict H). NEVER valid in any member, known or unknown: personal names, personal phone numbers, person-level records (§7.1 join prohibition) — enforced by the validator's deny-pattern pass, which schema alone cannot express.
